answer_1.quote: Conversational speech synthesis (CSS) systems are required to generate speech with conversational interaction prosody... Finally, we feed the encoded interaction features... into the speech synthesizer to help the agent in synthesizing speech that aligns with conversational interaction prosody.

answer_2.quote: For objective evaluation, we compute the Mean Absolute Error of Pitch (MAE-P) and Mean Absolute Error of Energy (MAE-E)... Additionally, we measure the Mel Cepstral Distortion (MCD)...

answer_4.quote: For subjective evaluation, we use the Dialogue-level Mean Opinion Score (DMOS). The evaluation is conducted by 20 graduate students... we employ a 1-5 scale for Naturalness DMOS (N-DMOS) and Prosody DMOS (P-DMOS)...
answer_4.guideline: 1-5 scale ratings for N-DMOS and P-DMOS
